caption: A button on a vending machine is pressed, and a can drops inside the machine and lands in the tray at the bottom.

sa.check: A button on a vending machine is pressed.
A can drops inside the machine.
It lands in the tray at the bottom.
The can is visible behind the glass as it falls.
The press comes first and the drop follows.

pc.expect: The can starts to fall after the button is pressed and not before.
pc.fail: A can drops with no button being pressed; or the button is pressed and nothing in the machine moves; or the can is already lying in the tray before the press.

pc.expect: The can drops downward inside the machine, quicker as it falls, and comes to rest in the tray.
pc.fail: The can drifts sideways across the shelves as it falls; or it hangs in the air inside the machine; or it climbs back up to its shelf.

pc.expect: One can leaves the shelf and the same one arrives in the tray.
pc.fail: A second can appears during the fall; or the can vanishes on the way down; or the shelf still holds its full row after a can has dropped.

pc.expect: The can stays a rigid cylinder and clatters against the glass and the tray.
pc.fail: The can bends or crumples as it falls; or it bounces around the tray like a rubber ball without settling; or it sinks into the floor of the tray.

pc.expect: The can, the glass and the machine's shelves stay solid and separate.
pc.fail: The can passes through the glass front; or it passes through the shelf below it; or it merges with another can in the rack.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The can's label, the machine's front and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The can changes label or colour as it falls; or the machine's buttons rearrange between frames; or the room behind the machine changes.
